name: epoch
description: Epoch workspace for core SDK, CLI, and WASM hosts.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @epoch/core && npm run build -w @epoch/cli && npm run build -w @epoch/wasm && tsgo -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @epoch/core && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/cli && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/wasm && tsgo -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.features: npm run build -- --pretty false && cucumber-js features/**/*.feature --require dist/test/features/**/*.js
scripts.coverage: npm run build -- --pretty false && c8 --all --check-coverage --lines 80 --branches 70 --functions 80 --statements 80 --reporter=text --reporter=lcov --include "dist/packages/**/*.js" --exclude "dist/test/**" cucumber-js features/**/*.feature --require dist/test/features/**/*.js
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run coverage
